title: Identify users who earned a 'Student' badge and also authored at least one
question: Identify users who earned a 'Student' badge and also authored at least one post in 2011 with more than 20,000 views. For each such user, return their display name and the total number of distinct users who commented on any of their posts created in 2011.

prediction.sql:
SELECT
    u."XCL_055" AS display_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT c."XCL_010") AS total_distinct_commenters
FROM users u
JOIN badges b
  ON u."XCL_052" = b."XCL_002"
JOIN posts p
  ON u."XCL_052" = p."XCL_033"
LEFT JOIN comments c
  ON p."XCL_026" = c."XCL_006"
WHERE b."XCL_003" = 'Student'
  AND STRFTIME('%Y', p."XCL_029") = '2011'
  AND p."XCL_030" > 20000
GROUP BY u."XCL_052", u."XCL_055"

measures.eligibility_application: Comments are restricted to posts that satisfy the 2011 and >20000 views eligibility conditions via the WHERE clause on the joined posts table.

The submitted SQL restricts the comment count to posts that *also* satisfy the >20,000 views condition because the WHERE clause filters the `posts` table before the `comments` join.
